title: Runtime-mutable RUST_MCP_MODE and A2A_MODE
summary: Adds runtime-mutable override for RUST_MCP_MODE and RUST_A2A_MODE via admin API, allowing operators to flip between modes without a process restart, and introduces a swappable MCPIngressMount and nginx-style Rust public proxy.
before_state: RUST_MCP_MODE and RUST_A2A_MODE were not runtime-mutable
after_state: RUST_MCP_MODE and RUST_A2A_MODE are runtime-mutable via admin API
